batchSize.description: The size of a batch in the {@link BatchJob}.

batchByDiagnostic.description:
Whether or not the {@link DataDiagnostic} will run its logic separately in its own batches.
When true the filter for the diagnostic is split across batches so as to run expensive diagnostics
in a distributed way. When false the diagnostic is placed in its own batch in a {@link BatchJob}
and can be placed with other diagnostics in that batch.

title:
Type which is used by a {@link DataDiagnostic} to determine if it should be broken into its own batches
during its evaluation in a {@link BatchJob}.
name: DataDiagnosticBatchConfig
